package.name: mgg_argos
package.description:
Runs the MGG planner against the ARGoS simulator.
Holds both ends of a small binary protocol: a ROS 2 node that publishes /clock, odometry, lidar point clouds and TF, and the ARGoS loop function and controller that feed it and drive the robots with the paths that come back. ARGoS never links against ROS 2, so the two only share include/mgg_argos/protocol.h.
The ARGoS half is built only when ARGoS is installed; the ROS 2 bridge builds either way.
